articles.title: Gavin and Stacey icon Ruth Jones reacts to co-star Melanie Walters' Strictly news with hilarious message from Nessa to Gwen
articles.summary: Melanie Walters, known for her role as Gwen in the BBC series 'Gavin and Stacey', is joining 'Strictly Come Dancing' next month. Her co-stars from the hit show will be supporting her during her participation. This news details her entry into the popular celebrity dance competition, highlighting an update from the entertainment industry regarding a well-known public figure.

articles.title: The Brink of War: Reagan & Gorbachev's Nuclear Talks
articles.summary: The 1986 Reykjavik Summit featured US President Ronald Reagan and Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev in unexpected, extended talks. Originally planned for two days, discussions broadened significantly, focusing on nuclear arms reduction. While no final agreement was reached, the summit marked a crucial turning point in the Cold War, laying groundwork for future disarmament treaties and significantly de-escalating tensions between the two superpowers, impacting global security.

articles.title: US Navy and Lockheed Martin test AI sonar system at RIMPAC 2026
articles.summary: The US Navy and Lockheed Martin have successfully tested AI-equipped Sikorsky MH-60R Seahawk helicopters off Hawaii for anti-submarine warfare. These modified aircraft used a new AI sonar system to hunt submarines, showcasing a significant advancement in naval defence capabilities. This integration of artificial intelligence into critical military operations enhances detection and offensive precision, highlighting the future direction of maritime security technology.

articles.title: Barcelona identify 21 G/A Villarreal striker as Julian Alvarez Plan B amid €65m asking price
articles.summary: Barcelona is intensely pursuing the signing of Julian Alvarez but is unwilling to wait indefinitely for Atletico Madrid to agree to the transfer. The Catalan club is actively pushing the operation forward, highlighting its determination to secure Alvarez despite potential stalemates with Atletico regarding the deal's progression.

articles.title: Russia, India, and China forge new trade routes in the Arctic Sea as Western sanctions lose their bite
articles.summary: The Arctic Ocean is becoming a critical new trade frontier. Russia is aggressively fortifying its military presence in the region while simultaneously attracting Asian economic powers to navigate and develop new Arctic routes. This dual strategy underscores Russia's ambition to assert geopolitical dominance and leverage the Arctic's economic potential, significantly impacting global power dynamics and future trade corridors.

articles.title: Thyssenkrupp Raises Outlook Slightly on Steel, Warship Gains
articles.summary: German industrial giant Thyssenkrupp AG has raised its full-year profit guidance, citing strong performance from its steel and crucial naval divisions. This positive financial outlook comes despite a challenging global industrial environment, underscoring the resilience and strategic importance of its defence manufacturing capabilities, particularly in naval shipbuilding, which plays a vital role in international defence markets.

articles.title: Tata group stocks mixed a day after Chandra's exit; check winners & losers
articles.summary: Most Tata group stocks rebounded after earlier losses, reflecting market volatility within India. While overall gains were observed across many firms, Titan and Tata Investment Corporation notably lagged behind. Tata Consultancy Services, the group's most valuable company, also experienced significant market movement. This reflects the dynamic nature of corporate financial performance and stock market trends in the national economy.

articles.title: Defence Ministry floats Rs 1 lakh crore tender for transport aircraft
articles.summary: The Indian Defence Ministry has issued tenders for a significant procurement of new military transport aircraft (MTA), estimated at ₹1 lakh crore. This competitive process aims to bolster the Indian Armed Forces' strategic airlift capabilities and logistical support. For SSB aspirants, this highlights ongoing defence modernization efforts and the substantial investment in enhancing operational readiness and strategic reach.
